Wolt says on its own website that it charges commission but gives no rates. We could not check Lieferando’s rates. That commission applies to regulars who pre-order with you, too.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?
faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system works from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your till is a question for your tax adviser.
faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.

preorder.label: Pre-orders with a chosen collection time
preorder.explain: Customers order in advance and choose the time they collect.

capacity.label: Collection times limited by kitchen capacity
capacity.explain: Customers only see collection times the kitchen can actually make.

asap.label: Orders for as soon as possible
asap.explain: Customers can order without choosing a time and collect as soon as it is ready.

ahead.label: Order ahead for a later day or event
ahead.explain: Customers can order today for a market or event on a later day.

schedule.label: Weekly schedule with changing locations
schedule.explain: The truck's week of places and times; customers order for the place and day it is there.

walkup.label: Walk-up orders on the same screen as online orders
walkup.explain: Orders taken at the window go into the same list as online orders.

stock.label: Sold-out and stock limits per event
stock.explain: Mark dishes sold out and set how many of each can be sold at an event.

notify.label: Customers told when their order is ready
notify.explain: How customers hear their order is ready: SMS, WhatsApp, email, push or a live order-status page.
notify.ours: email when the order-ready step is on, and an order-status page; no SMS, WhatsApp or push

allergens.label: Allergens on the menu
allergens.explain: Each dish shows its allergens to customers before they order.

menuphoto.label: Menu set up from a photo
menuphoto.explain: A photo or PDF of the menu fills in the dishes for you to check.

options.label: Options and extras on dishes
options.explain: Sizes, sauces and extras, including choices the customer must make.

deals.label: Meal deals and bundles
deals.explain: Several items sold together at one price.

private.label: Private events and bookings
private.explain: Orders for a private event through its own link, and requests to book the truck.
private.ours: private events with their own order link; no booking requests

qr.label: Table / QR ordering at seats
qr.explain: Customers scan a code at their table and the order arrives with the table number.
qr.ours: a QR code opens the order page; no table numbers

cards.label: Online card payments incl. Apple Pay and Google Pay
cards.explain: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay when they order.

payattruck.label: Pay at the truck
payattruck.explain: Customers order online and pay when they collect.

localpay.label: Local payment methods (BLIK, iDEAL, Swish, MobilePay…)
localpay.explain: The country's own online payment methods, besides cards.

paypal.label: PayPal or Klarna
paypal.explain: Customers can pay with PayPal or Klarna.

custfee.label: Option for the customer to pay the order fee
custfee.explain: The business can pass a service fee on to the customer.

tips.label: Tips
tips.explain: Customers can add a tip when they pay online.

paymethods.label: Payment methods offered
paymethods.explain: How customers can pay, as the vendor states it.
paymethods.ours: card, Apple Pay, Google Pay; pay at the truck

kds.label: Kitchen display (KDS)
kds.explain: Orders appear on a screen in the kitchen, in the order to make them.

tickets.label: Printed kitchen tickets
tickets.explain: Each order prints on a receipt printer in the truck.
tickets.ours: in the iPad and Android app; printer not supplied

buzzers.label: Buzzers
buzzers.explain: Customers get a buzzer that tells them their order is ready.
buzzers.ours: buzzer numbers recorded with each order; buzzers not supplied

offline.label: Keeps working if the internet drops
offline.explain: Orders and changes made without a connection are kept and sent once it is back.
offline.ours: in the iPad and Android app; not in the web dashboard

vans.label: Several vans or trucks
vans.explain: One account runs more than one truck.
vans.ours: extra vans for an added monthly fee

staff.label: Staff logins
staff.explain: Staff sign in with their own login and role.

reports.label: Sales reports
reports.explain: Totals, best sellers and sales by event or date, with a spreadsheet export.

domain.label: Own web address
domain.explain: The ordering page on the business's own domain.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp auto-replies
whatsapp.explain: Customers' WhatsApp messages are answered automatically.

social.label: Social media posts from your schedule
social.explain: Ready-made posts showing where the truck is this week.

igmsg.label: Instagram and Messenger replies
igmsg.explain: Instagram and Facebook Messenger messages are answered automatically.

discovery.label: Listed on a food-truck discovery map
discovery.explain: Customers find the truck on a public map of food trucks near them.

loyalty.label: Loyalty
loyalty.explain: Customers collect rewards for coming back.

ipad.label: iPad app
ipad.explain: The truck's app for taking and managing orders on an iPad.

android.label: Android app
android.explain: The same app on an Android tablet or phone.

hardware.label: Hardware supplied (tablet, printer)
hardware.explain: The vendor provides the tablet or the printer.

terminal.label: Card reader for the window supplied
terminal.explain: The vendor provides a card reader for payments at the truck.

fiscal.label: Certified till for tax rules (TSE, EET, kassaregister…)
fiscal.explain: A till certified for the country's rules on recording sales.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.explain: Orders delivered to the customer's address.

monthly.label: Monthly price
monthly.explain: What the business pays each month for the software.

perorder.label: Fee per online order
perorder.explain: What the vendor charges on each online order, on top of the monthly price.

cardfee.label: Card fee
cardfee.explain: The payment provider's fee on each card payment.

term.label: Minimum contract
term.explain: How long the business is tied in before it can cancel.

trial.label: Free trial
trial.explain: Time to use the system for free before paying.
